styles.name: Pixel art
styles.context: Character authoring with separate Human Folk and LPC Adventurer contracts
styles.status: Existing external direction; new lab application open
styles.notes: Local browse label, not an exported model ID. Family, body variant, frame layout, palette and animation compatibility remain separate. Edu's documented consumer accepts Human Folk compact schema-v2 JSON; LPC support does not establish consumer compatibility.

styles.name: Bright Cartoon
styles.context: Human world; character finish remains a separate question
styles.notes: Rounded practical construction and broad readable groups. Local 3D browse placement does not make the direction medium-exclusive. Human environment measurements do not complete character materials. Pastoral, frontier and shadowed are proposed zone labels, not extra style IDs or approved models.

styles.name: Noir Graphic
styles.notes: Dark but colourful graphic construction, sweep, taper and deliberate negative space. The source direction is not medium-exclusive; local 3D grouping selects no renderer. Outlines remain parked with an owner-level conflict; clay form studies do not mandate clay surfaces.

styles.name: Bright Clay
styles.status: Working trial direction; scoped studies retained
styles.notes: Bright pressed/formed masses. Marker-04, C2 and Shelf B KEEP remain bounded study decisions, not an accepted production dialect. Bright/dark browsing is useful, while plush_clay remains a separate source term. Clay appearance does not select stop-motion animation or a frame rate.

styles.name: Dark Clay
styles.context: Troll; exact character and zone scope open
styles.status: Working trial direction; scope awaits Q120
styles.notes: Darker clay is a retained trial name. Material, palette, mood and territory are separate open application questions. No Troll studio is selected by this index, and the name does not mandate black surfaces, horror or a specific animation technique.

styles.name: Plush Clay
styles.notes: Plush-informed full, gentle clay volumes. Preserve this third clay vocabulary entry while the requested bright/dark primary browse organization is refined. Literal fur, felt, seams, shaders and deformation are unselected; the term does not define every environment asset.

styles.name: Bold Toy
styles.notes: Bold convex cartoon/toy construction. Historical matte and shape constraints remain unless specifically replaced. The word toy selects neither glossy vinyl nor a renderer, palette, trained model or production material.

styles.name: Turned Toy
styles.notes: Turned-part profiles, local axes and fitted repetition. Gnome remains brick-free and separate from goblin-town construction. Profile features need not become independent components; gears, articulation, wood grain and final finish remain separate questions.

styles.name: Mended Ceramic
styles.status: Working trial direction; retained character register
styles.notes: Cared-for, visibly repaired ceramic-like construction; anti-horror and no green. The declined gothic puppet is not a parallel current choice. Exact ceramic, palette, repair material, gloss, environment application and production route remain open.

styles.name: Studded Brick
styles.context: Goblin-run neutral towns and their props
styles.notes: Studded construction-toy assemblies. This is a place/prop scope, not a ninth playable race. Gnome remains brick-free; goblin NPCs in another race's chunk follow that chunk's style. Brand dimensions, snap mechanics, batching and final plastic finish are not established by the label.

styles.name: Bright Cartoon Dusk (historical)
styles.status: Retired from the active list on 2026-10-10
styles.notes: Searchable historical vocabulary from the supplied draft. Do not start a fourth base trial, new asset version or trained-model track from this retired name. Duskwood now uses Human construction plus a proposed shadowed zone variant; older Human-dark evidence remains retained.
